eventDetail.scope: The conference covers an array of critical topics including Devices, Circuits, and Systems, VLSI and Nanotechnology, Computer Architecture and Embedded Systems, Signal Processing and Multimedia, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, and Robotics and Cybernetics. These tracks highlight the fundamental role of technology in shaping the future of electronics, communications, and computing.  Further extending its relevance, ICMSS explores fields such as Communications Networks, IoT, Antenna and Microwave Techniques, Security and Privacy, and Control and Automation. With a focus on both hardware and software, the conference bridges the gap between theoretical research and practical applications.
